resources.string: Keeps the songs you like on this phone, a few at a time, while it charges.
Fills spare room with songs you are likely to play next, judged from when and how often you play them.
Turn off to let downloads use mobile data too. Downloading still waits for the phone to charge.
Downloading stops once downloads take up this much.
Removes every downloaded song from this phone. They still play by streaming.
Every downloaded song is removed from this phone and plays by streaming from now on. Liked songs download again later if downloading liked songs stays on.
There is no room left on this phone for more music. Free up some space and downloading picks up again by itself.
How much recently played music is kept to replay without data. Takes effect the next time Wanda starts.
